name: Set E
description: Follow-up questions: each is asked after a recorded first turn, and only makes sense with it ("And for 2027?"). Remote AI rewrites each into a question that stands alone; the rewrite is checked, then retrieval, then the answer.
source: Written for RAG Studio on 2026-10-16. Every answer was found in the PDFs' extracted text, and every page that states it is listed (spec §5.4).

history.question: What is the growth forecast for South Asia in 2026?
history.answer: The report forecasts South Asia's real GDP growth at 6.3 percent in 2026.

questions.question: And for 2027?
questions.note: 6.9 percent (2027f). p26 and p189 print South Asia as 6.6 6.8 7.0 6.3 6.9 for 2023-2027f. A4's 'about 7 percent' is the 2027-28 average; 6.9 is the 2027 figure.

history.question: What is the total carbon footprint of the iMac?
history.answer: The iMac's total product footprint is 346 kg CO2e for the two-port 256GB configuration, and 391 kg CO2e for the four-port 512GB one.

questions.question: How much of that is transportation?
questions.note: 5% (Production 50%, Transportation 5%, Product use 45%, End-of-life <1%). The pattern must not accept the 45% of product use.

questions.category: Follow-up: a detail of the answer

history.question: How many depository libraries did GPO staff visit in FY 2018?
history.answer: GPO staff visited 166 depository libraries in FY 2018.

questions.question: In how many states?
questions.note: 25 states: 'GPO staff visited 166 depository libraries in 25 states' (pp. 5 and 21).

questions.category: Follow-up: an earlier thing, not the answer

history.question: What new digital system replaced FDsys?
history.answer: GPO's new system is govinfo, the successor to its FDsys website.

questions.question: When was the old system retired?
questions.note: FDsys was scheduled for retirement in December 2018 (pp. 4, 8, 10, 22). The report says 'scheduled' and 'goal of retiring', so 'planned for December 2018' is a right answer.

questions.category: Follow-up: the same figure, another year

history.question: What is the global growth forecast for 2026?
history.answer: Global growth is projected to slow to 2.5 percent in 2026.

questions.question: What was it in 2025?

history.question: What was GPO's net income in FY 2018?
history.answer: GPO's net income was $52.6 million in FY 2018.

questions.question: And the year before?
questions.note: FY 2017 net income was $58.9 million; the report's adjusted figure for FY 2017 is $38.3 million, and p44 calls that one plain 'net income' too (see D3). Either is right.

questions.category: Follow-up: a thing the documents do not have

history.question: How much of the iMac's carbon footprint comes from product use?
history.answer: 45 percent of the iMac's carbon footprint comes from product use.

questions.question: What about the MacBook Air?
questions.note: A trap: no document mentions the MacBook Air. The rewrite should ask about its product-use share, and the answer must be the refusal.

history.question: How many depository libraries did GPO staff visit in FY 2018?
history.answer: GPO staff visited 166 depository libraries in 25 states.

questions.question: What is the iMac stand made of?
questions.note: 100 percent recycled aluminum (pp. 1, 2, 4). The rewrite must not carry the GPO conversation over: it is a new subject.
